item.description: Donald Trump spent his Saturday posting fake pictures of himself again. Between attacking his own prosecutor and declaring victory in Iran, he made time to publish 43 posts in an afternoon. In one he kisses a golden Jesus. The fakes are his claims that he is holy, that he is young, that the world is his to take.
